brief: Two-day workshop in Leipzig for 30 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-02-16. Keep it as cheap as possible, budget EUR 10,000.

input.summary: Two Leipzig seminar hotels are available on 2027-02-16 and within the EUR 10,000 budget. The cheapest town option, Kesselhalle Plagwitz (EUR 7,770), is on the blocked vendor list, so I left it out. Both offers are reachable from Berlin by a 75-minute train ride.

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest compliant option, with four workshop rooms and a maker space; gives up the preferred-vendor status of Auwald.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Preferred vendor, calm and well run with a garden; EUR 420 more than Druckerei Forum and a quieter setting.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: Request for proposal: 2-day workshop, 16-17 Feb 2027, 30 guests
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a two-day workshop and would like a proposal.

Dates: arrival 2027-02-16, 1 night, departure 2027-02-17.
Guests: 30.
Room nights: 30 single-occupancy rooms for 1 night.
Meeting space: 1 main meeting room for both days. No breakout rooms needed.
Catering: lunch and coffee on both days. Dietary needs: none reported.
Accessibility: no wheelchair users.
Budget: all-in total under EUR 10,000, so please quote your best rate.

Please reply with availability and a total price by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
